say:0:1710710101:1.text: From the start, he had no right to draw the sword. He is not of the Augusta line and therefore has no claim to the throne.
say:0:1710710101:1.source_cn: 奥利安自身并不具备拔剑的资格——他并非奥古斯都的后裔，...
